_about: Predefined review checklists. These are procedural prompts for a decision-support prototype, not medical instructions. Replace them with your mission's approved health procedures.

CL-HR-01.title: Heart-rate change review
steps: Confirm the sensor is worn correctly and the device reports good signal quality.
Repeat the heart-rate measurement after 5 minutes of rest.
Check the timeline for recent exercise, EVA preparation or high-workload tasks.
Record how you feel in a daily check-in (include notes).
If the change persists, report it to mission control / the crew medical officer per mission protocol.

CL-SPO2-01.title: Blood-oxygen reading review
steps: Check sensor placement and that the reading is not affected by movement or cold hands.
Repeat the SpO₂ measurement at rest.
Check the cabin environment status display (CO₂ / ventilation) for this module.
Report persistent changes to mission control per mission protocol.

CL-TEMP-01.title: Body-temperature change review
steps: Confirm the measurement method and sensor contact.
Repeat the measurement after 15 minutes at rest away from exercise equipment.
Check cabin temperature for your current module.
Note any symptoms in a daily check-in and report persistent changes per mission protocol.

CL-SLEEP-01.title: Sleep-disruption review
steps: Review the last sleep periods against the scheduled sleep window.
Check crew quarters for light, noise and temperature issues.
Review the schedule for upcoming critical tasks that may need adjustment.
Discuss sleep with mission control / the crew medical officer per mission protocol.

CL-FATIGUE-01.title: Fatigue increase review
steps: Complete a daily check-in describing workload and how you feel.
Review recent workload and rest periods on the mission timeline.
Consider whether safety-critical tasks should be double-checked by a crewmate.
Report sustained fatigue changes to mission control per mission protocol.

CL-MULTI-01.title: Multi-indicator pattern review
steps: Review each affected indicator below against your personal baseline.
Repeat continuous measurements at rest and confirm sensor quality.
Complete a daily check-in with notes on sleep, workload and how you feel.
Review the upcoming timeline for safety-critical tasks.
Contact mission control / the crew medical officer and follow the mission health procedure.
